note: Family campground on NY-122 near Constable (Franklin Co), on 57 acres in pines along a river that loops through the park, plus seasonal sites. Pool, rec center, kayak rentals. Google 4.7 over 201 reviews. --Claude
summary: Operator's 2026 rates confirm $30 (waterfront no-hookup) to $40 (full-hookup pull-through), +$5 holidays; NEW: Campspot booking, season May 15 - Oct 15, full hookups (water/sewer; amps not stated), pull-throughs, showers, laundry, store, dump, free WiFi. Under the US$50 gate; working site + phone + engine; nightly rates posted (seasonal sites exist but transient sites book nightly). flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: the operator sells 'Deluxe Waterfront - Water and Electric' and 'Waterfront - No Hookups' sites on 'our river that runs through the park', and Campspot lists 'Waterfront'; the entry is 'riverview'.
